summary.text: Gilbert Frieden is the Transparency Inclusion Environment Party candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 5th Essex District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Democrat Andrew Tarr and Republican Christina Delisio.
He was also on the ballot as an unenrolled candidate in the March 31, 2026 special general election for the seat, in which he received 6.8 percent of the vote.
